observations: Photo shows a vertical stack of five used tires viewed from the tread/shoulder angle only
Tread grooves are visible and appear to have usable depth on the top few tires, but no ruler or depth gauge is shown
Sidewalls, DOT codes, brand names, and size markings are not visible in this photo
A watermark text 'ABDULWAHEED DAMOLA' overlays the image, seller's own stamp, not a size or brand label
No visible bulge or patch on the visible tread faces, but sidewalls (where bulges/patches usually show) are not shown

claims.evidence: Tread grooves look present in photo 0 but no depth gauge or ruler shown to confirm a percentage
Photo 0 only shows tread faces stacked together; sidewalls where patches/bulges/plugs are usually visible are hidden
No DOT/manufacture date code or vehicle documentation visible in photo 0

risks.risk: Tyre size (width/profile/rim diameter) unknown, which drives price heavily
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the sidewall showing the size code, e.g. 205/55R16
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without size; treat as unknown-size generic used tyre, lowest tier

risks.risk: Actual manufacture date (DOT code) may show the tyre is much older than the '2023 car' claim implies, since tyres can be older than the car
risks.proof: Photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (4-digit week/year stamp)
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, worst case aged stock

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, patches, plugs, or bulges not visible from the tread-only angle
risks.proof: Photos of both sidewalls of the specific tyre being sold, flat on the ground

risks.risk: Unclear how many tyres are actually for sale (single piece vs set of 4/5) and whether they're matching
risks.proof: Seller confirms quantity and photographs the exact tyre(s) being sold laid out individually
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unverified tyre, not a matched set

risks.risk: Actual tread depth not measurable from this angle/photo quality
risks.proof: Close-up photo with a tread depth gauge or coin inserted in the groove
risks.if_unproven: priced as minimum legal/worn tread, not 90 percent

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the sidewall showing size code and DOT date stamp
Photo of both sidewalls of the actual tyre(s) for sale, laid flat
Photo with a tread depth gauge or coin in the main groove
Confirmation of exact quantity being sold and whether sizes match
response.reason: The tyre size and sidewall condition, which set the price tier and reveal hidden damage, are not visible in the single tread-only photo provided.
